## What’s new
- Add time for a subcontractor from the normal New Log form: pick them in the new Resource menu (it defaults to you). - Mac notifications for invoice drafts to review, automatic transfers to confirm, overdue invoices, payables due, and timers running long. Turn each on or off — and set how long counts as “long” — in Settings › Notifications. - Cash Flow shows the next 8 weeks of money in and out, with a running total. - Reports › Profit shows profit and margin by client and project for any period. - Finance numbers refresh when something changes instead of every 15 minutes, which keeps Beacon lighter.

## What’s new
- Automatic invoice drafts: turn on “Create invoice drafts automatically” on a company and Beacon drafts its invoice on schedule (the 1st for monthly companies, Mondays for weekly). Drafts wait for your review — nothing is sent automatically. - Remove individual lines from a draft invoice; their time logs go back to unbilled. - Subscriptions paid by automatic transfer: each month’s entry appears on the 1st with a Confirm received button, and you can keep a subscription out of your monthly goal.

## What’s new
- Reports › Billing history stays up to date as you invoice and get paid, and each invoice counts toward its “Counts toward” month (or invoice date). - The goal month picker is easy to read. - Updates install the newest version on the first try.

## What’s new
- Fixes a freeze that could happen when switching to the Dashboard right after sending an invoice. - Tab switching and large tables are smoother.

## What’s new
- Every report and table fills the window and lets you resize columns by dragging the header edges. - Right-click any column header to sort or group by that column, low to high or high to low. Each report remembers your widths, sort, and grouping. - A company’s Invoices tab is grouped by year and shows Days to pay — how long paid invoices took, or how long open ones have been waiting. - Beacon opens filling your screen, and headers and toolbars adapt when the window is narrower instead of cutting off buttons. - Invoice composer descriptions grow to show the full text.

## What’s new
- New invoices show a checkbox on every line. Uncheck lines to hold them for a later invoice; their time logs stay unbilled and appear on the next invoice for that client.

## What’s new
- Finance admins now see the goal section in the sidebar: invoiced, active work, and goal progress with pace. The goal month is shown for reference; only the owner can change it.

## What’s new
- Payee photos now appear in the Cash Flow and Payables “Waiting on client payment” tables instead of initials.

## What’s new
- Goal tracking now lives at the bottom of the sidebar, and the right rail is gone, so tables and the timeline get the full window width. - Users and Settings moved into the menu on your name, making room for the full goal card on laptop screens. - Today’s hours and waiting proposals show next to Time, and a running timer gets its own row with a Stop button. - The Cash Flow “Waiting on client payment” table shows each payee’s avatar.

## What’s new
- A fresh look: a navy sidebar and goal rail, a calm sky-blue accent, flat surfaces with no heavy gradients, and the Manrope typeface throughout. - The dashboard greets you and highlights “Earned this month” in a navy tile. Tables and the Day timeline show each client’s color and emoji. - The collapsed goal rail now shows a pace-colored goal ring, earned this month, today’s hours, the running timer, and proposals waiting for review. - Invoice PDFs use Manrope with proper bold headings and totals, and full dates no longer get cut off.
